died: c. 202 (Lyon, traditional; martyrdom not verified in this task)
language: Greek (writings survive mainly in Latin translation; Greek fragments)
role_place: Bishop of Lugdunum (Lyon), Gaul; student-chain link to Polycarp (as reported by Irenaeus and Eusebius)
why_relevant: Against Heresies Book IV is the main Father-level treatment of the OT/NT relation (one author, Law as provisional and pedagogical) and contains a reported peace-over-excommunication letter; it contains adverse OT-stoning and divine-fire statements.
